text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
And that sees the end of my third<n>year with Super
Creek.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The motherly Umamusume and<n>greenhorn trainer
are now known as<n>a top-class duo.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: One day, at tryouts...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
So many people are approaching me...<n>I have no
idea what I should do.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Who should I choose? Hmm,<n>decisions, decisions...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: What's the matter?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Oh! You're Super Creek!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Could you offer me some advice for<n>picking a
trainer? I'm having trouble<n>deciding.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Goodness me. Have you been<n>approached by a ton
of candidates?

Yeah, all sorts. From those who look<n>like they'd
train me well to others<n>who seem to be very
knowledgeable.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
But I don't know which trainer would<n>be the best
for my future.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hmm... For your future, huh?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Well, the answer's simple! ♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Choose someone who you think you<n>can do your
absolute best for.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: What? I'm the one who has to put inthe effort? Isn't the trainer supposedto put in the effort for me?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Yes, but I believe that it's more<n>important to
prioritize giving over<n>taking.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: It's a necessary part of racing—andyou do want to continue racingtogether in the long run, right?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Th-that never even crossed my<n>mind...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer! ♪ Nothing, just a bit of<n>chitchat.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I'll see you around! ♪

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Okay! Thank you very much!

Aww, I'm so jealous of Super Creek<n>for getting
approached by such a<n>gifted trainer.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
She mentioned giving more than<n>taking, but there
aren't any trainers<n>out there who give as much as
hers.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hehe, did you hear that? You're a<n>gifted trainer.
choice_data_list: I, too, was once a totally average trainer.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: That's not true! I bet you were<n>always gifted.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
You just needed a little time to realize<n>what those
gifts were...
choice_data_list:
Did you honestly think I was gifted from the very
beginning?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hmm... It's hard to say...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
But it doesn't matter whether you're<n>gifted or just
average.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I can still depend on you to stay with<n>me to the very
end. Right?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
For me, my desire to do things for<n>you will never
change.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
If anything, that desire might even be<n>greater than
when we first met.
choice_data_list: Fine, I'll allow you to keep spoiling me.
Fine, I'll allow you to keep spoiling me.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, thank you! I was right about<n>there only being
one way to choose a<n>trainer.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
You choose someone you want to do<n>things for...
because Umamusume are<n>givers. ♪

Another year, another new cohort of<n>Umamusume
starting at Tracen<n>Academy, ready to be nurtured.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
But Super Creek is probably the only<n>Umamusume
who nurtures her<n>trainer.
